stages.title: 청크 분석
stages.system: You are a precise curriculum-analysis extractor. Output strict JSON only.
stages.note: D1/D2 (2026-07-21): concepts[].unit_id added + 'Overview' literal example replaced with a <placeholder> pattern. WHY: a real 251-page run had nearly every concept land in one giant 'Overview' unit (p.1-251) -- root-caused to (a) concepts had no unit_id so makeUnitMap() could only guess chunk.units[0] for multi-unit chunks, and (b) the old example's literal "unit_id":"01","unit_title":"Overview" got echoed verbatim across many of the 26 independent chunk calls, so unrelated chunks collided under the same unit_id at merge time. COST: response schema changed -- only affects new runs, not past saved data. EXIT: if collisions persist even with unit_id present, escalate to a code-level fix (namespace unit_id by chunk at collection time) instead of further prompt tweaks.

stages.system: You revise a page-grounded curriculum unit_map to address specific audit issues, without inventing content or page citations that aren't backed by the provided source chunk evidence.
stages.note: D174 Phase 3: NEW stage, no real-pipeline equivalent (refine_once() is audit-only there) -- the actual 'apply the fix' step Codex's plan recommended keeping separate from p01-3's own audit call, so the auditor never grades its own edit. Only invoked for actionable issue_types (duplicate_exact/overbroad_unit/boundary_split_needed); its output is REJECTED by p01-runner.js's validateUnitMapGrounding() if it fails grounding checks, never accepted blindly.
